privacy.text: Privacy Privacy PolicyHow Evy collects, uses, protects and shares personal data across the mobile app, website and browser experience. Effective date: 17 July 2026Last updated: 30 October 2026 On this page Controller Scope Data Sources Purposes Legal Bases Sharing International Ai Retention Security Rights Children Deletion Changes Contact Who is responsible for your dataEshap – Agence de communication Sàrl is the controller responsible for the processing described in this Privacy Policy. Eshap – Agence de communication Sàrl Route du Lac 1141787 Môtier, Switzerland UID/VAT No.: CHE-195.045.289 Email: info@myevy.app Scope of this PolicyThis Privacy Policy applies to the Evy mobile applications, the website at myevy.app, the browser version of Evy and related support services. It explains what personal data we process, why we process it, with whom it may be shared and the choices available to you. Personal data we processAccount and profile dataEmail address, password authentication data, name, username, profile image, date of birth and profile details you choose to provide. Location and event activityApproximate location or location selected by you, searches, filters, viewed events, favourites, participation status, events created or managed, and interactions with event pages. Content and communicationsEvent descriptions, images, links, comments, messages, reports, support requests, notification preferences and other content you submit. Device, log and security dataIP address, device and browser type, operating system, app version, language, timestamps, crash information, authentication events, security logs and similar technical data. Analytics and website dataWhere you consent, we may use Google Analytics or a comparable analytics service to understand website and product usage. This may involve online identifiers, approximate location, device information and interaction data. Subscriptions and purchase verificationWhere subscription features are available, Apple App Store or Google Play processes the payment. Evy and RevenueCat process the Evy account identifier, store transaction or purchase identifiers, product, subscription status and paid periods to verify access, synchronize renewals, restore purchases, prevent misuse and provide support. RevenueCat also provides subscription analytics. Evy does not collect the payment card number used by the store. Public availability of new subscriptions is controlled separately from these verification services. How we obtain dataWe obtain data directly from you, automatically from your device when you use the Service, from other users who interact with or report content, and from service providers that support authentication, hosting, analytics, notifications, security and moderation. Why we process personal datacreate and secure accounts;provide event discovery, publishing, favourites, participation, messaging and profile features;display approximate location-based results and relevant event information;send transactional emails, service messages and push notifications;answer support requests and communicate important changes;detect spam, abuse, fraud, harmful content and security incidents;moderate reported or potentially violating content;measure and improve performance, reliability and user experience;comply with law, enforce our terms and protect users and third parties.Legal groundsDepending on your location and the processing concerned, we rely on one or more of the following grounds: Contract: processing necessary to provide the Service you request and administer your account.Legitimate interests: operating, securing, improving and protecting Evy, preventing abuse and understanding service performance, balanced against your rights.Consent: for optional analytics, certain notifications, device permissions or other processing where consent is required. You may withdraw consent at any time.Legal obligations: processing needed to comply with applicable law, lawful requests or record-keeping duties.Protection of vital interests or legal claims: in exceptional safety, emergency or dispute situations.Who may receive personal dataWe do not sell personal data. We may disclose data to: Supabase: database, authentication, storage and backend infrastructure. The selected project region is Stockholm, Sweden (Northern Europe).Infomaniak: website hosting and related infrastructure in Switzerland.AI moderation providers: currently OpenAI services may be used to analyse content for safety and policy compliance when moderation features are enabled.Analytics providers: Google Analytics may be used on the website or product only where configured and, where required, after consent.RevenueCat and app stores: RevenueCat processes subscription and purchase records on our behalf for verification, restoration, entitlement synchronization and subscription analytics. Apple and Google operate their respective purchase and subscription services under their own applicable privacy policies. Purchase records are associated with the Evy account identifier.Notification platforms: Apple Push Notification service and Google/Firebase services may process device tokens and delivery data to send push notifications.Professional advisers and authorities: where reasonably necessary for legal advice, audits, claims, safety or compliance with binding requests.Business transaction recipients: in connection with a merger, restructuring, financing or transfer, subject to appropriate safeguards.Providers may only process data for defined purposes under contractual and legal obligations. International data transfersData is primarily hosted in Switzerland and the European Economic Area, including Sweden. Some providers or their subprocessors may process data in other countries. Where required, we use recognised safeguards such as adequacy decisions, standard contractual clauses, contractual protections and supplementary technical or organisational measures. AI-assisted moderationEvy may submit text or other limited content to an AI service to help identify spam, harassment, illegal content, scams or other potential violations. Automated analysis may produce an alert or recommendation; it does not necessarily result in automatic enforcement. Cases may be reviewed manually, particularly where context or uncertainty matters. We aim to minimise the information sent for moderation and avoid sending data that is not needed for the safety purpose. Do not include sensitive personal information in public event descriptions, messages or reports unless it is strictly necessary. You may contact us to request review of a decision that significantly affects your account or content. How long we keep dataWe retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described above: account and profile data while your account remains active;User Content until you delete it, the account is deleted, or it is removed under our rules; support, moderation, security and legal records for a period reasonably necessary to investigate incidents, enforce rules, resolve disputes and meet legal obligations;analytics data according to the retention configuration of the relevant analytics service. After an account-deletion request is verified, active account data is generally deleted or anonymised within 30 days. Residual copies may remain in encrypted backups for up to 90 days before normal rotation, unless longer retention is legally required or necessary for fraud prevention, safety, disputes or the protection of rights. Data securityWe use technical and organisational measures designed to protect personal data, including encrypted network connections, access controls, authentication safeguards, logging, backups and least-privilege practices. No online service can guarantee absolute security. You are responsible for choosing a strong password and protecting access to your email account and devices. Your privacy rightsDepending on applicable law, you may have rights to: receive information about processing and obtain a copy of your data;correct inaccurate or incomplete data;request deletion or restriction;object to certain processing based on legitimate interests;withdraw consent without affecting earlier lawful processing;receive certain data in a portable format;request human review where a legally significant decision is based solely on automated processing;complain to a competent data-protection authority.To exercise a right, email info@myevy.app. We may need to verify your identity. Rights may be limited where an exemption applies or retention is legally required. Children and ageEvy is not specifically directed to children. If you are under the age required to enter into a legally binding agreement under the laws applicable to you, you should only use Evy with the permission and supervision of a parent or legal guardian. If we become aware that personal data has been collected from a child in circumstances where parental authorisation was legally required, we may remove the account and delete the associated data. Event organisers remain responsible for setting and enforcing any event-specific age restrictions. Account and data deletion More information about account deletion, retention and recovery is available on our Account Deletion page. Changes to this PolicyWe may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes to Evy, service providers, technology or law. The updated version will be posted here with a revised date. We will provide additional notice where a change materially affects your rights or is otherwise required. Contact and complaintsFor privacy questions or requests, contact: Eshap – Agence de communication Sàrl Route du Lac 1141787 Môtier, Switzerland UID/VAT No.: CHE-195.045.289 Email: info@myevy.app You may also lodge a complaint with the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner or, where the GDPR applies, with the supervisory authority in your country of residence or work.

cookies.text: Cookies Cookie Policy Clear information about cookies, analytics and similar technologies used by the Evy website and browser app. Effective date: 17 July 2026Last updated: 17 July 2026 On this page Overview Technologies Categories Analytics Consent Duration Controls App Changes Contact OverviewThis Cookie Policy explains how Evy uses cookies and similar technologies on myevy.app and the browser version of Evy. It should be read together with our Privacy Policy. A cookie is a small text file stored by a browser. Similar technologies include local storage, session storage, software-development kits, pixels and device identifiers. Technologies we may useCookies: small browser files used for preferences, sessions, security or analytics.Local and session storage: browser storage used to remember settings or support app functionality.SDKs and device identifiers: technologies used in mobile apps for authentication, diagnostics, notifications and analytics.Pixels or tags: code that helps measure page usage or campaign performance where enabled. Cookie categoriesCategoryPurposeConsentStrictly necessarySecurity, authentication, session continuity, load balancing, consent storage and core website functions.Used where necessary to provide the requested service.PreferencesRemember language, display choices and other optional settings.Consent may be requested where required.AnalyticsUnderstand visits, feature usage, performance and errors.Activated only after consent where applicable.MarketingMeasure campaigns or personalise advertising.Not currently planned for launch; would require prior consent where applicable. Google AnalyticsWe may configure Google Analytics to understand how visitors use the website. Depending on configuration, Google may receive identifiers, IP-derived approximate location, browser and device details, pages viewed, interactions and timestamps. Where consent is required, analytics will remain disabled until you choose to accept it. We recommend using consent mode, limiting retention, disabling unnecessary advertising features and applying privacy-focused configuration. Consent choicesWhen optional cookies are used, the website should display a consent interface that allows you to accept or reject non-essential categories. Rejecting optional cookies should not prevent access to core website functions. You may change or withdraw your choice through the cookie settings interface when available. Withdrawal does not affect processing that occurred before the change. How long technologies remainSession technologies expire when you close the browser or shortly afterwards. Persistent technologies remain for a defined period or until you delete them. Exact durations depend on the purpose and provider. Evy will periodically review configured durations and avoid keeping identifiers longer than reasonably necessary. Browser and device controlsMost browsers allow you to view, block and delete cookies. Blocking strictly necessary technologies may affect login, security or other functionality. Mobile operating systems also provide controls for notifications, permissions, advertising identifiers and app data. Cookies in the mobile appTraditional browser cookies are generally not the main technology used inside the native mobile app. The app may instead use secure local storage, SDKs, device tokens and identifiers for authentication, notifications, diagnostics, moderation and service operation. These practices are described in our Privacy Policy. Changes to this PolicyWe may update this Cookie Policy when technologies, providers or legal requirements change. The current version and update date will remain available on this page. Contact Eshap – Agence de communication Sàrl Route du Lac 1141787 Môtier, Switzerland UID/VAT No.: CHE-195.045.289 Email: info@myevy.app

community-guidelines.text: Community Community GuidelinesSimple rules that keep Evy useful, authentic and safe for attendees, organisers and local communities. Effective date: 17 July 2026Last updated: 17 July 2026 On this page PurposeAuthenticityRespectSafetyIllegalSexualPrivacySpamRightsOrganizersReportsEnforcementAppeals A community built around real experiencesEvy helps people discover and share events. These Guidelines apply to event listings, profiles, images, comments, messages, links and all other activity on Evy. They are designed to protect users while allowing diverse communities and events to thrive. Be authenticPublish only real events that you are authorised to promote.Use accurate dates, locations, prices, ticket links and organiser details.Do not impersonate a person, venue, brand or organisation.Do not create misleading pages, fake attendance, false reviews or fabricated urgency.Update or cancel listings promptly when circumstances change.Respect everyoneHarassment, bullying, threats, stalking, humiliation, targeted abuse, hateful conduct and discrimination are not allowed. Do not attack people based on protected or personal characteristics. Disagreement is allowed; dehumanisation, intimidation and repeated unwanted contact are not. Protect physical safetyDo not promote credible threats, instructions to cause serious harm, dangerous challenges, weapons trafficking or content that creates an immediate safety risk. Organisers must communicate material safety rules and must not conceal known hazards. In an emergency, contact local emergency services. Evy is not an emergency-response service. No illegal activity, fraud or exploitationNo scams, phishing, malware, counterfeit tickets or deceptive payment requests.No promotion or coordination of unlawful goods, services or activities.No exploitation, trafficking, coercion or facilitation of abuse.No unauthorised gambling or activities requiring licences that the organiser does not hold.No attempts to bypass legal age restrictions, venue requirements or official controls.Sexual content and protection of minorsSexual exploitation, non-consensual intimate content, grooming and any sexual content involving minors are strictly prohibited. Explicit sexual content or nudity that is unsuitable for a general event-discovery platform may be removed even where it is not unlawful. Respect privacyDo not publish private contact details, home addresses, identity documents, financial information, private conversations or precise live location without permission. Do not record or share identifiable people from private settings where consent is reasonably expected. No spam or platform manipulationDo not repeatedly post duplicate events, send bulk unsolicited messages, manipulate favourites or participation, use bots, scrape user information, evade restrictions or direct users to harmful or misleading websites. Respect intellectual propertyUse only photos, logos, music, descriptions and other material that you created, licensed or are otherwise authorised to use. Credit alone does not automatically give permission. Rights holders may contact us to report infringement. Extra responsibilities for organisersProvide a reachable and identifiable organiser contact where appropriate.Comply with permits, licences, insurance, venue, accessibility, capacity and safety requirements.Clearly disclose ticket prices, mandatory fees, refund terms and age restrictions.Do not imply that Evy sponsors, verifies or guarantees an event unless we have confirmed this in writing.Respond responsibly to attendee concerns and report serious safety incidents.Reporting concernsYou can report an event, profile, comment or message using the reporting controls in Evy. Provide enough context for review and do not knowingly submit false or abusive reports. For urgent legal or safety concerns, email info@myevy.app. How we enforce these rulesWe may use automated detection, including AI-assisted moderation, together with human review. Depending on severity, history, context and risk, action may include reduced visibility, removal, warnings, feature restrictions, suspension, permanent account termination, preservation of evidence or referral to authorities. We may act immediately where there is a serious risk of harm, fraud, exploitation or unlawful activity. Moderation systems are not perfect, and absence of removal does not mean that content is endorsed. Appeals and questionsIf you believe that content or an account was restricted by mistake, contact info@myevy.app with the relevant details. We will review reasonable appeals, but we may not disclose confidential security methods, reporter identities or information that would endanger others.

child-safety.text: Safety Child Safety Standards Evy is committed to protecting children and young people from sexual abuse, exploitation, grooming and other harmful behaviour across our platform. Last updated: 17 August 2026 On this page Our commitment Prohibited behaviour CSAM Reporting Moderation Enforcement Authorities Safety contact Our commitment Evy maintains a zero-tolerance approach to child sexual abuse and exploitation (CSAE), child sexual abuse material (CSAM), grooming, sextortion, trafficking and any behaviour intended to sexually exploit or endanger a child. These standards apply to all content and interactions on Evy, including event listings, profiles, images, comments, private messages, links and other user-generated content. Prohibited behaviour The following behaviour is strictly prohibited on Evy: Sexual exploitation, abuse or sexualisation of children. Grooming or attempting to establish contact with a child for sexual purposes. Sextortion, sexual coercion or threats involving intimate content. Soliciting, sharing, producing or distributing sexual content involving minors. Facilitating child trafficking or sexual exploitation. Attempting to direct users to external platforms for the purpose of exploiting a child. Encouraging or assisting others in any of the activities above. Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) Child sexual abuse material is strictly prohibited on Evy. When we become aware of suspected CSAM, we may immediately remove the material, restrict or terminate the associated account, preserve relevant information where legally necessary and take further action required by applicable law. Users must never upload, forward, reproduce or attempt to obtain CSAM through Evy. Reporting child safety concerns Users can report inappropriate or harmful content directly within the Evy application using the reporting tools available on profiles, events, messages and other supported content. Reports related to child safety are treated as a priority. If you cannot use the in-app reporting tools, you may contact us directly at info@myevy.app. If a child appears to be in immediate danger, contact the appropriate local emergency or law-enforcement authority. Evy is not an emergency-response service. Detection and moderation Evy uses a combination of automated systems and human review to help identify potentially harmful or policy-violating activity. Automated moderation may assist in identifying suspicious content or behaviour. Where necessary, potentially serious or uncertain cases may be escalated for human review. No automated moderation system is perfect. Users are therefore encouraged to report concerning activity whenever they encounter it. Enforcement Where we identify a violation of these standards, Evy may take action including: removing content; restricting messaging or other platform features; suspending an account; permanently terminating an account; preserving evidence where legally necessary; reporting serious matters to relevant authorities where required or legally appropriate. Serious child-safety violations may result in immediate account termination without prior warning. Compliance and cooperation Evy complies with applicable child-safety laws and responds to valid legal requests from competent authorities. Where required by applicable law, Evy may preserve or disclose information relevant to investigations concerning child sexual abuse or exploitation. Child safety contact Child safety questions, reports or compliance enquiries may be addressed to: Evy / Eshap – Agence de communication Sàrl Route du Lac 114 1787 Môtier Switzerland Email: info@myevy.app UID / VAT: CHE-195.045.289

support.text: Support How can we help? Find answers to common questions, learn how to manage your account, or get in touch with the Evy team if you need a hand. Contact Support Email us What do you need help with? Choose a topic below to quickly find the right information or support resource. 👤 Account & Profile Get help with your account, profile information, password and account settings. Get account help → 📍 Events Need help creating, editing, publishing or managing an event on Evy? Get event support → ⚙️ App & Technical Issues Something is not working as expected? Tell us what happened and we’ll help investigate. Report a technical issue → 🛡️ Reports & Safety Report inappropriate content, harassment, fake events or behaviour that violates our rules. View Community Guidelines → 🔐 Privacy & Data Learn how Evy handles personal information, data retention and privacy rights. View Privacy Policy → 🗑️ Delete Your Account Learn how to request account deletion and what happens to your data afterwards. Account deletion information → Frequently asked questions Quick answers to some of the most common questions about Evy. Do I need an account to use Evy? No. You can browse public events without creating an account. An account is required to save events, interact with the community, publish events and use other personalised features. How do I reset my password? From the Evy login screen, select “Forgot password?” and follow the instructions sent to your registered email address. Can I publish an event on Evy? Yes. Registered users can create and publish events, provided that the event complies with our Terms of Service and Community Guidelines. How do I report an event or another user? Use the report option available directly within Evy. Reports may be reviewed using automated moderation and, where necessary, human review. Serious safety concerns can also be sent to info@myevy.app. I found a bug. What should I send to support? Tell us what happened, what device you are using, what version of Evy you are running and, if possible, include a screenshot. These details help us reproduce and investigate the issue more quickly. How do I delete my Evy account? Account deletion can be requested directly from your account settings inside Evy. You can also review the full deletion process on our Account Deletion page. Still need help? Can’t find what you’re looking for? Send us a message and the Evy team will get back to you as soon as possible. Contact Support info@myevy.app

account-deletion.text: Account control Delete your Evy account Delete your account directly in the app. Effective date: 17 July 2026Last updated: 17 July 2026 On this page In App Deleted Retained Timeline Before Contact Delete your account in the Evy appThe fastest method is inside Evy: Sign in to your Evy account.Open Profile and then Settings.Select Account.Select Delete account and follow the confirmation steps.Your account remains recoverable for 30 days after you request deletion. After this recovery period expires, deletion becomes permanent and the account can no longer be restored.” Data deleted or anonymisedOnce a valid request is completed, we delete or anonymise data associated with the account, including profile information, authentication records, favourites, participation data, notification preferences and content where deletion is appropriate. Messages or content shared with others may remain in anonymised or limited form where necessary to preserve conversation integrity, safety reports or legal records. Limited data we may retainWe may retain limited records where necessary for legal obligations, security, fraud prevention, abuse investigations, dispute resolution or the protection of rights. Residual copies may remain in encrypted backups until normal backup rotation is complete. Deletion timelineWe generally complete verified deletion requests within 30 days. Encrypted backup copies may remain for up to 90 days before normal rotation. We will inform you if a lawful exception requires a longer period. Before deleting your accountDeletion is not the same as logging out or uninstalling the app.Events you manage may be removed or detached from your profile.Saved favourites, participation history and account settings will no longer be available.Download or save anything you need before submitting the request.
